# HHMI BioInteractive

> > Educational resources for biology teachers and students featuring interactive lessons, films, and data analysis activities on ecology, genetics, evolution, and conservation.

HHMI BioInteractive provides award-winning classroom materials developed by the Howard Hughes Medical Institute, including case studies like The Biology of Skin Color, conservation projects in Gorongosa National Park, and biodiversity research from The Great Elephant Census to the Bird Genoscape Project.

## Key Topics

- ecology
- biodiversity conservation
- genetics
- human evolution
- climate change
- skin color and UV adaptation
- environmental science
- data analysis
- Gorongosa National Park
- African elephants
- The Biology of Skin Color
- The Great Elephant Census
- educational resources for high school
- film-based activities
- wildlife genetics

## Ecology & Ecosystems

- [Topic 4: Ecology](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/194): Ecology curriculum resources covering biodiversity and climate change
- [Topic 2: Ecosystems & Ecology](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/216): Ecosystems & ecology curriculum with conservation biology activities

## Biodiversity & Conservation

- [Topic 3: Biodiversity & Conservation](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/217): Biodiversity conservation resources featuring wildlife genetics & ecology
- [Gorongosa](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/270): Gorongosa National Park wildlife conservation & restoration resources

## Human Genetics & Evolution

- [Skin Color](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/260): Human evolution & genetics resources on skin color and UV adaptation

## Cell Biology & Disease

- [Cancer](https://www.biointeractive.org/taxonomy/term/256): Cancer genetics & cell biology educational resources for AP Biology
